blocks.body:
## Current verdict

Nimbo is **not ready to scale acquisition**. The August 29 canonical public-rank evaluation still fails every required goal surface and the verified streak remains 0/7: Apple `weather` search is #81, the official Apple Weather chart is outside the first 100, all three fixed logged-out Google category profiles are outside the first 30, and 0/5 generic Google queries qualify. The historical iOS 1.0.1 crash still has no symbolicated diagnostic; product commit `9342824` retains reachable-path and fail-closed surface hardening and adds the durable first-forecast activation tip, but current preventive tests cannot identify or close the historical event. OpenMeteo GmbH confirmed non-commercial API entitlement in ticket `234272` for the exact free, non-monetized, unpaid-organic-promotion scope. Exact phone and Wear AABs embed `9342824`, pass Bundletool validation, and have zero signature entries. Exact Apple app, widget, and watch simulator executables have UUID-matched dSYMs but are ad-hoc products; an exact-source device archive attempt failed at Widget CodeSign and produced no archive. Exact-product EN/RU/UZ iPhone captures pass current-UI provenance and the first five stories now use distinct source/focus compositions, but this is screenshot evidence only and does not establish conversion lift, signing, physical QA, TestFlight readiness, or publication. The exact debug phone path passed the durable-tip CTA, persistence, and cold-start flow on a physical API 25 phone, and a fresh no-snapshot API 24 emulator rerun passed live forecast, persisted tip acknowledgement, offline cache, recovery, and the bounded TLS/fatal/ANR log check. Prior widget and API 37 round-Wear evidence remains historical; there is no exact-current signed phone/Wear artifact, distribution-signed Apple archive, or matching physical matrix. Android Keychain metadata and the existing mode-600 keystore are present, but no protected value was retrieved and upload signing remains unavailable. At 20:44 +05:00 the iPad was again available and paired, but lock-state and DDI queries failed because it had not been unlocked recently; the iPhone and watch remained unavailable. Google Play Custom Store Listing `4834799756935529888` remains an Uzbekistan-only draft, Apple subtitles remain unpublished drafts, and none of the new store payload is public. The domain and point-in-time store-policy gates remain `pass`, every critical console guardrail remains unknown, and the Play conversion denominator is still unreconciled. Scale status remains `hold`; public outreach and acquisition scaling remain gated on crash diagnosis, source-synced signed phone, Wear OS, and Apple artifacts, complete physical-device coverage, and critical console guardrails.

## Operating rule

Unknown quality, provider, release identity, domain, or physical-device evidence is never converted into a pass. External UI side effects remain action-time gated by the execution surface, and the zero-budget boundary remains in force.

accessIssues.message: Raw App Store Connect and Play Console exports with country, source, device, version, and denominator definitions are not attached.

App Store Connect confirms one crash on iOS 1.0.1 on August 25, 2026, but privacy suppression exposes no report, stack, UUID, device, or OS. Product commit 9342824 retains the reachable-path hardening and passes the current Apple surface suite and simulator builds; this preventive evidence does not identify or close the historical crash.

Product commit 9342824 has no signed phone vc8 or Wear 1000008 artifact and no distribution-signed Apple build 6. Both current-source Android AABs have zero signature entries; the Apple app, widget, and watch outputs are ad-hoc simulator products, and the exact-source device archive attempt failed at Widget CodeSign. The exact debug phone paths passed bounded physical API 25 durable-tip QA and fresh no-snapshot API 24 live/cache/recovery QA, while exact-product EN/RU/UZ iPhone captures pass current-UI provenance; neither result satisfies signing or the physical matrix. Full SHA-256 identities remain in the gate evidence. Android Keychain metadata and the mode-600 keystore are present but no protected value was retrieved. At 20:44 +05:00 the iPad was paired but had not been unlocked recently, so lock-state and DDI queries failed and CoreDevice readiness must be re-established.
All eight critical console guardrails lack complete decision-eligible evidence; unknown remains blocking even though the separate point-in-time operational policy-console checks passed.

-- Reproducible bounded snapshot of the reported store-console baseline.
-- Values preserve each console metric as reported; they are not recomputed
-- across incompatible denominators.
SELECT *
FROM (
  VALUES
    ('App Store', 'Impressions', '206', 'reported_console_readout'),
    ('App Store', 'First-time downloads', '5', 'reported_console_readout'),
    ('App Store', 'Conversion rate', '4.05%', 'reported_console_readout'),
    ('App Store', 'Ratings', '0', 'reported_console_readout'),
    ('App Store', 'Crashes', '1', 'live_console_2026-08-29'),
    ('Google Play', 'Impressions', '779', 'reported_console_readout'),
    ('Google Play', 'Installations', '21', 'live_console_2026-08-28'),
    ('Google Play', 'First launches', '14', 'live_console_2026-08-28'),
    ('Google Play', 'Monthly active users', '11', 'live_console_2026-08-28'),
